youtube.title: Good Morning Bible Verse | Colossians 3:23 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. Heading to work? Take this with you.

"And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;" Colossians 3:23 (KJV)

Whatever's on your schedule today, do it like he's the one you're working for. Because he is.

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.

#MorningPrayer #BibleVerse #KJV #BlessedPrayers #shorts
